name: io.github.REPLACE_GITHUB_USER/xrpl-agent-tools
title: XRPL Agent Tools (x402)
description: Pay-per-call agent tools (web to Markdown, XRPL data, file conversion, JSON utils) paid via x402 in XRP or RLUSD.

environmentVariables.name: XRPL_SEED
environmentVariables.description: Seed of a dedicated low-balance agent wallet that pays per call. Never use a main wallet.

environmentVariables.name: X402_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: xrpl:1 (testnet, default) or xrpl:0 (mainnet; also needs X402_ALLOW_MAINNET=true)

environmentVariables.name: SESSION_BUDGET_XRP
environmentVariables.description: Total XRP the server may spend per session
